visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features hands splitting open a hot-pressed toasted sandwich, revealing a generous layer of pale purple taro paste on one side and a golden egg and corn filling on the other. The lighting is warm, emphasizing the crispy, browned texture of the bread's exterior. (2) The scene shifts to another sandwich variant where melted white cheese stretches as the bread is pulled apart, uncovering pieces of savory meat and more corn kernels. The camera captures the steam and glossy finish of the ingredients, suggesting freshness. (3) A montage of the preparation process follows, showing white bread slices on a metal grill. Metal tongs are used to carefully layer ingredients such as shredded cheese, vibrant yellow corn, and marinated meat strips. A square slice of yellow cheese is added to a stacked sandwich before the press is closed. (4) More food varieties are displayed: a thick slice of toast topped with a dark, textured black sesame paste is drizzled with glistening white condensed milk. Another sandwich is torn open to show a dense combination of taro paste and fluffy brown meat floss. (5) A fried meat snack on a wooden skewer is held against a branded paper bag background, followed by a ladle pouring creamy yellow corn soup into a paper cup decorated with a cartoon cat. (6) Two cups of dark and light-colored tea are held up in a celebratory gesture. The video concludes with a close-up of a detailed menu board and a final shot of the restaurant's illuminated outdoor signage and seating area at night.
